column1: Jackson Chourio leads the slate with a strong track record of consistency, hitting safely in nearly 75% of his games and showing a recent uptick at the plate. He gets the platoon advantage against Andrew Abbott, a lefty who allows limited hits but presents a manageable matchup. Jake McCarthy is also in a favorable spot atop the order at home, benefiting from a hitter-friendly park. Alec Burleson and Pete Crow-Armstrong offer additional options but carry less recent reliability.
